description: React component for displaying a cloud trial announcement banner with logic for dismissal, modal interactions, and localized messages.

classes.name: CloudTrialAnnouncementBarInternal
classes.description: React component class managing the display and behavior of the cloud trial announcement banner.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Handles closing the banner, saving preferences based on days left in trial.

methods.name: shouldShowBanner
methods.description: Determines if the banner should be shown based on user and trial status.

methods.name: isDismissable
methods.description: Checks if the banner can be dismissed based on days left in trial.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the announcement banner with appropriate message and icon based on trial days.
